name: ddaro
description: Worktree-per-session git workflow for parallel Claude Code sessions: isolated worktree + branch per session, deletion-aware commits with automatic context snapshots, PR merges driven through CI, crash recovery, protective hooks (main protection, branch naming), and an opt-in merge gate (merge_gate strict: a scripted /ddaro check ties PASS to the commit; gh pr merge is blocked without it). Per-command instruction files keep token use low.
